name: Huayna Picchu
why: The steep peak behind Machu Picchu: Inca stairs to terraces on the summit and the whole citadel straight below.
book: A Machu Picchu ticket that includes Huayna Picchu (limited per time slot), booked months ahead for May-September.
water: Carry 1 litre; no food allowed in the citadel.
dangers: Narrow Inca steps with long drops; not for vertigo.
turnaround: You must be back at the control by the time on your ticket.

points.name: Huayna Picchu control, Machu Picchu
points.note: The control hut past the Sacred Rock, at the north end of the citadel: sign in and out with your Huayna Picchu ticket.

points.name: Huayna Picchu Inca stairs
points.note: Narrow Inca steps cut into the cliff, steel cables to hold; very steep and slippery when wet.

points.name: Huayna Picchu summit terraces
points.note: About 2,690 m: terraces near the top, a tight squeeze through a rock tunnel, then Machu Picchu straight below.
